exposure: manual removal of the placenta without intrauterine cleaning
spontaneous placental delivery without intrauterine cleaning
manual removal of the placenta with intrauterine cleaning
spontaneous placental delivery with intrauterine cleaning
outcome: maternal acceptability in terms of overall discomfort
cohort: 436 pregnant women at term who were intended for elective cesarean delivery
finding: Manual removal of the placenta and intrauterine cleaning have no deleterious impact on maternal blood loss and infectious morbidity after elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Intrauterine cleaning was associated with faster cessation of lochia and faster return to daily activity.
